Package frc.robot.utils

Class HubSchedule

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.utils.HubSchedule
public final class HubSchedule extends Object
Pure (no WPILib / DriverStation) model of the 2026 REBUILT teleop hub schedule, so it can be unit tested.

All times are seconds remaining in teleop, counting down from TELEOP_LENGTH: Transition 140→130 (both hubs active), Shifts 1-4 at 25 s each (130→105→80→55→30, hubs alternate), End Game 30→0 (both hubs active).

Boundary convention: a time exactly on a boundary belongs to the earlier phase (e.g. 130.0 is still HubSchedule.Phase.TRANSITION, 30.0 is still HubSchedule.Phase.SHIFT_4, 0.0 is HubSchedule.Phase.ENDGAME).
